tei:div.tei:p: "$ (451)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba'i phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(452)༄༅// na mo gu ru we/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtsug rgyan ni gu ma// gdams pa'i srol byed shangs pa gdu bu ba// rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub thob sle ber can// kun dga' grol mchog rnams la phyag bgyi'o// khyod sku mdzes pa 'jam mnyen pad dkar bzhin// khyod gsung snyan pa dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i gtam// khyed thugs zab pa mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// dbang gi rgyal po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ḍā ki'i zhal rlangs dngar ba'i bdud rtsi'i ro// khyud po'i snyan brgyud 'dzin ma las bltams pa'i// lam zab rin chen 'brus mdzes byin rlabs gter// bde chen snye ma 'bri la gnang ba stsol// 'dir mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor las brgyud pa'i rtsa ba ni gu chos drug /sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med dang lnga ni gdams ngag 'di'i lugs kyi snying po yin zhing*/ de las gzhan du gsang sgrub skor gsum dang bka' srung mgon po'i skor sogs cha lag mang du yod pa las sdong po phyag rgya chen po'i skor la thog mar gwa'u ma'i dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis kyi dang po maṇḍal pad 'dab bzhi phyogs tshon la lte ba ser po// de'i mthar ci 'byor pa'i mchod gtor gyis bskor/ slob dpon gyis bde mchog lhan skyes ser po'am/ ni gu'i byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi skabs bzhin sngon po'i bdag bskyed (452) yi ge bdun pa'i bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed maṇḍal la dmigs nas/ sumbha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rin po che'i khri seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan chas brgyan pa// yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa/ mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i shar gyi 'dab ma'i steng du dgos pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs/ lhor gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs/ nub tu ma hā mā yā'i lha tshogs/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hūm̐ sna tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i rnam par bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan (453)drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ lnga ka la rigs bdag rgyal ba rigs lngas rgyas gdab// yang na rigs bdag rang chas can du bsam yang rung*/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar nas arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dril bsil dang dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal// thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// dges mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa// dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud//

ces rang rang gi bstod pas bstod/ yang na lnga tshar la/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ gtor ma sumbha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ sarba (455)ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// ces bstod pa bya/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol// bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ maṇḍal/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs gsol ba gdab/ rgyun bshags sogs dkyus bzhin/ thod pa'i nang du rang lus bdud rtsir bsam zhing*/ thog ma med pa nas kyi lus longs spyod dge rtsa rnams stong gsum gser gyi rnam par bsgyur te yid kyis 'bul/ dbang bzhi bskur bar gsol ba btab// dbang bzhi blang*/ rjes gtso bos sogs slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin bdag 'jug byed do// ༈ gnyis pa slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral la 'khod de maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan nas nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rdo rje 'chang la dngos su thug pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu mas/ mkhas grub chen po mnyam med shangs pa gdu bu pa khyung po'i rnal 'byor la dngos su gdams pa'i gser chos lnga'i nang tshan sdong po phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i dbang 'bul ba skabs su babs pa yin/

de la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// (456)mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag kyang 'jug par 'tshal// gsum/ de nas mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum/ slob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i steng du bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog ser btso ma lta bu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan chas brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon bdag nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa ltar ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ spos rol bya zhing ye shes dbab/ de nas dbang bskur bya ba ni/ khyed rang slob ma rnams rang rang gi mdun du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam la 'bul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang stong gsum 'di'ang gser gyis bkang la yon du 'bul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang ba zhu/

bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu (457)rgyun 'od dkar po'i rnam par byon te bla ma'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung*/ khyed rang gi smin phrag gi oṃ la thim pas lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa sangs kyis dag par bsam mdzod/ bla mas kyang de bzhin du bsam la ngag tu/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig / ces brjod cing yi ge bdun pa dang dril bsil bya/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs shing bum pa'i dbang bskur thob byung snyam du mdzod/ yang thod pa'i nang du lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam nas snga ma ltar mchod/ stong gsum gser gyis bkang la yon du phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'od dmar po'i rnam par byon te/ bla ma'i āḥl thim/ āḥlas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa sangs kyis dag par bsam mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du= sngags dang rol mo sngar bzhin byed pa 'og ma dag la 'gre/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la= yang thod pa'i nang du lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam nas snga ma ltar mchod/

stong gsum gser gyis bkang la yon du phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i (458)thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'od sngon po'i rnam par byon te/ bla ma'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa sangs kyis dag par bsam mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs brjod/ thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs shing shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur thob byung snyam du bsam mdzod/ yang thod pa'i nang du rang lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam nas snga ma ltar mchod/ stong gsum gser gyis bkang la yon du phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'od sna tshogs kyi rnam par byon te/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge la thim/ de las 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung*/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad 'od kyis gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ lus lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos par bzhag pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// sngags dang dril bsil// ye shes rgya mtsho las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor la// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// sa lam rim pa ma lus bgrod// ces lan gsum brjod/

de phyi'i dbang ngo// yang shar gyi dges rdor 'od du yal/ dbus kyi bde mchog la (459)thim/ de bzhin du rim gyis yal bas dbus kyi bde mchog la thim/ bde mchog de'ang 'od du ltem ltem 'dug pa de khyed rang gi spyi gtsug tu thim pas/ smin mtshams su slebs pa las bum dbang*/ mgrin par sleb pa las gsang dbang*/ snying khar slebs pa las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ lte bar slebs 'od du yal nas lus stong sangs song ste/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang lus sems ma bcos par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste nang gi dbang bzhi'o// sngags dang dril bsil/ rjes mchod bstod bzod gsol gshegs bsdu bya ba nyid do// ga'u ma'i dbang bzhi zin bris yin/ dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis rdzong dga' ldan du phyag len bzhin bkod pa'o// zhes pa'i yi ge gzhir byas nas yig rnying la gtugs te bklag chog tu bris pa'o// ga'u ma'i khrid dang rgya brten lung gi skor ma chad pa gal che/ 'dir phyag chen bka' lnga ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i ga'u ma'i dbang dang*/ lus 'chi med dang*/ sems 'chi med dang*/ dug lnga lam khyer dang*/ lam khyer rnam gsum mo// ༈ lus 'chi med kyi bka' bzhugs so// ༈ lus 'chi med kyi bka' ni/ sbyor ba maṇḍal pad ma 'dab bzhi/ lte ba mthing kha/ 'dab ma bzhi phyogs mdog bri/ de'i mthar mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ slob dpon stan la 'khod do// dngos gzhi bdag mdun gnyis kyi dang po bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems tshad med sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma'i steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po// mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan can/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/

hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gnas gsum byin rlabs byas la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ yi ge bdun pa ci nus bzla'o// de nas gnyis (460) pa mdun bskyed la dmigs te swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sems rang snang gi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po sogs nas bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing kha/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ste bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

zhes lha lnga'i gnas gsum byin rlabs byas la/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa lha lnga spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra sngon du 'gro bas arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ gong gi sa pā ri wā ra'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las sogs kyi bstod/ mdun gyi gtor ma sumbha sa bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la gong gi sa pā ri wa ra 'i mthar i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyi 'bul/ phyi (461) mchod/ nang mchod/ skyabs sems bya/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad blos ling gis bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la phul la gsol ba gdab pa sogs 'og tu slob ma la ji lta ba bzhin gyi dbang bzhi blang*/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyang brjod/ de slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa'o// de nas slob ma nang du bos la 'di'i sngon de ma thag byin rlabs gzhan dang ma 'brel na bgegs gtor btang la slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces bya ste/

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa gsal btab gsan 'tshal/ de la dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos rnams kyi nang nas phyag chen bka' lngar grags pa las/ da len 'dir lus 'chi med kyi bka' yin ces sogs ci dang ci 'dra ba brda sprad/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa sngon du grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i mdun bskyed 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs kyi rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma skad cig gis padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa'i steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan can/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum nas bzhugs pa/ slob (462)dpon he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha lnga'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa ltar ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa'i mthar/ badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ/ zhes brjod la ye shes pa dbab cing dril bsil bya/ de nas lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung ba zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/

tshar gcig / de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo dbyer med pa'i bde mchog gi smin mtshams su oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hūm̐ sna tshogs kyi mdog can/ de'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las bde mchog dkar po sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa chad cing gar stabs su ling ling byung nas khyed rang gi spyi bo'i oṃ la thim pas/ spyi bo'i bde chen gyi gnas thams cad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces byas la dril bsil lam/ rol chen bya zhing*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rje btsun bir wa pas byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / ces brjod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ yang lus longs spyod nas/ bla ma rin po che bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las bde mchog dmar po sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa chad cing*/ gar stabs su ling ling byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi gnas thams cad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang (463)thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / ces sogs brjod cing rol chen bya/ yang sher dbang gi don du lus longs spyod thams cad nas/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las bde mchog sngon po sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa chad cing gar stabs ling ling byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas snying kha chos kyi gnas thams cad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig

/ ces sogs brjod/ yang dbang bzhi pa'i don du lus longs spyod rnams dngos sam yid kyis mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur la de thams cad bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lhan skyes tha mi dad pa la phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i lte ba'i hūm̐ sna tshogs mdog can las bde mchog sna tshogs 'od can sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa chad cing gar stabs ling ling byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i hūm̐ sna tshogs mdog can la thim/ yang spyi bo'i bde mchog dkar po mgrin pa'i bde mchog dmar po la thim/ dmar po snying ga'i bde mchog sngon po la thim/ mthing ga lte bar byung*/ 'od du yal song ste stong pa'i ngang las sems ma bcos par zhog mdzod/ zer ba byas la rol mo dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rje btsun bir wa pas byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang (464)mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /ces sngar bzhin brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin/ yang zab lam dbang du byas nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru mthing khar yod pa las bde mchog mthing kha dpag tu med pa chad nas khyed rang gi lte bar thim pas mthar stong sang gis 'od du yal song ba de ka'i ngang la cung zhig 'jog par zhu// 'di yang dbang bzhi pa lugs gcig yin no// bya ba brjod/ rjes gtso bo sa sogs dang*/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod yig brgya sogs spyi dang 'dra ba bya ste/ lus 'chi med kyi bka' bstan zin no// ༈ sems 'chi med kyi bka' bzhugs/ ༄// sems 'chi med bka' la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po shom dang*/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed mdun bskyed rnams bde mchog lha la ji lta ba bzhin bya ba'am/

yang na maṇḍal padma 'dab ma bzhi kha dog rnams gong gi 'di dang gcig rin/ bdag bskyed bde mchog la bya/ mdun bskyed ni phyag chen gyis skabs bzhin rgyud sde lnga'i lha la bya ba gdam pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po bdag 'jug ni/ slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin slob dpon rang gis slang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ maṇḍal 'bul ba nas/ slob ma bde mchog tu bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i rol chen yan lus 'chi med kyi skabs 'dra/ de nas slob dpon bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan rnams gsal btab ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa/ bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu (465)med pa byon/ khyed rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rje btsun bir wa pas byin= dpa' bo dang mkha'= / ces 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'khor lo bde mchog dmar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa/ bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis= yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'khor lo bde mchog sngon po sku chung la yan lag rags pa/ bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang gi snying ga nas zhugs/

lus thams cad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis= yang slob dpon gyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru rgyang ste chad/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du lam me zhugs/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sna tshogs pa sku chung la yan lag rags pa/ bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang gi lte bar zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa yin snyam pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ zhig rgyang ste chad/ khyed rang gi lte bar zhugs/ khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ de yang mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ āḥthugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang gi lus gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung pos gtsor byas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od du yal te stong (466)nyid du thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa bzla/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang bde mchog 'od kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bur lam gyis gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis lus sems 'chi med gnyis kyi bka' thob pa yin pas de'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom srung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ khrid rgyab chos dang bcas pa skabs 'dir yig rnying ltar ma chad pa gal che/ mjug chog sngar bzhin shes par bya'o/ tshig 'phrad bsgyur bkod ma gtogs pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung gtsang ma rtsa bar byas te/ yig rnying la gtugs nas bklag chog tu bris so/// / ༈ dug lnga lam khyer gyi bka' bzhugs/ ༄༅// bla ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dug lnga lam khyer gyi byin rlabs la/

sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi dang po ni/ maṇḍal bde mchog lha lnga'i skabs bzhin dang*/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed ga'u ma'i skabs bzhin bya/ phyag chen/ 'chi med 'di dang gsum ka stabs gcig tu byed na bdag bskyed thog ma'i gcig pu des chog /phyi ma gnyis la mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga ltar byas kyang rung*/ gang ltar gnyis pa bdag mdun bsgrub pa/ bdag 'jug slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin blang*/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sku tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan snyam du sems bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni mkhas grub chen po mnyam med khyung po rnal 'byor gyis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus pa'i chos skor rnams kyi nang nas phyag chen bka' lngar grags pa'i nang tshan sgyu ma lam khyer ram/ dug lnga lam khyer ces shin tu zab pa'i bka' 'bul bar byed pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsol 'debs/ rgyun bshags byas nas slob (467) ma bde mchog tu bskyed la ye shes dbab pa'i bar lus 'chi med kyi skabs su drangs pa bzhin bya/ de nas khyed rang rnams 'khor lo sdom pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can rtsa ba phra ba lte bar zug pa'i nang du raṃ dmar po/ rtse mo rgya gling gi gsham kha ltar sbom du song ba tshangs pa'i bu gar har re yod pa gsal btab/ tshangs bug gi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma bde mchog lha lnga bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha shas thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun shel dkar bzhu ba'i khu ba lta bur babs/

khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs// smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril bya ba 'og tu 'gre/ yang bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dkar dmar nyi zla 'dres pa lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus thams cad khengs pas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang mdun bskyed kyi yum las yum de 'dra ba zhig chad/ khyed rang bde mchog gi sku gsal ba'i yum rdo rje phag mo la thim/ de dang snyoms 'jug byas pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes te dbang gsum pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs khyed rang la thim pas je gsal je dwangs nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam la brjod med du mnyam par bzhag pas dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces so so'i mthar ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa bzla/ gtso bos sogs rjes kyi chos gsum dang mjug cho ga rnams babs thob shes par bya'o/// / ༈ lam khyer rnam gsum las bla ma lam khyer gyi bka' bzhugs// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bla ma lam khyer gyi dbang la gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po ni maṇḍal chang dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs nas de la padma 'dab bzhi lte ba ser/ shar mthing*/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ gong ras de nyid la myu khyud nag po// khyams phyogs mdog /de la me

(468) tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ mchod gtor dang tshogs bsham mo/ de nas gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed lha lnga'i skabs bzhin sngon du song bas/ mdun bskyed sumbha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'khor lo bde mchog tha dad med pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa sku mdog dkar gsal dang bcas pa'o// de'i shar gyi 'dab ma las dges mdzad rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhor gsang ba 'dus pa ser po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ nub tu ma hā mā yā dmar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ljang khu gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hūm̐ sna tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i rnam par bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badzrī bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ zhes gnas gsum byin rlabs dang dbang bskur bya/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar nas arghaṃ nas

shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra oṃ ā hūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rang gi snying kha nas so so'i yum rnams spros/ (469)de rnams dang snyoms par zhugs pas bde bas mnyes par gyur/ ces gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ yig rnying dang dag chos kyi zin bris gnyis las bdag 'jug gi gsal kha mi snang bas dpyad/ ༈ de nas slob ma rnams khrus phyag gis 'khor maṇḍal phul ba la 'di skad brjod/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos zab mo gsan la don nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab 'tshal/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor rnams las phyag chen bka' lnga'i nang tshan bla ma lam khyer gyi bka' 'bul ba yin/ de la bla ma'i bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma la bya rgyu'i chos de la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus lan gcig thob pa'i skabs 'dir lam zab mo la 'bad dgos/ de yang da lta nas ma 'bad na tshe la long med/ nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi la cha med/ 'chi tshe nor longs spyod sogs khyer dbang med/ sems khung med du mi 'gro bar skye ba len dgos/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rang la mi 'byung la gzhan rnams skyob thub pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las gzhan med pas de thob par bya dgos/ de'i slad du thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsum/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ (470)dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs gsum/ rang gi gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le byas pas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ byung ste/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis snying khar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ bdud rtsi byin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig srung na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badzra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ zhes dam bzhag bya/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol// gsum/ ngag dbang chos grags kyi yi ge dang yig rnying mthun par/ de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thun mong dang khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro/ smon 'jug gnyis su sems bskyed pa/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug /gsol ba gdab pa/ gnang ba sbyin pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ yan lag lnga bya ba/ gsang sngags 'byung ba dka' bar bshad pa'o// des sngon 'gro bcu pa la kha 'phang 'dug kyang 'di tsam mdzes so snyam nas bris so// gnyis pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/

de'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ shar du dges pa rdo rje dkar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhor gsang ba 'dus pa ser po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ nub (471)tu ma hā mā yā dmar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ljang khu gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa bskyed pa'i bla ma'i spyi bo nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bdud rtsi bla ma la bstim pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba rgyas par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril bya/ dbang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i don du khyed rang gi mdun du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang stong gsum 'di'ang gser gyis bkang ba'i maṇḍal phul bar bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes brjod pa dang bla ma'i sku dang zla ba'i gdan las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar po byung nas khyed rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang dang sprul sku thob byung snyam du bsam mdzod/ ḍā dril/ yang gong bzhin thod par lus bdud rtsir gyur pas mchod= gser gyi maṇḍal phul= 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsang ba'i dbang= gsung gi= zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi spyan drangs mgrin par thim pas de'i mgrin pa nas kyang bdud rtsi dkar dmar byung nas khyed rang gi lce thog tu slebs pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/

gsang ba'i dbang dang longs sku thob byung snyam du mdzod/ ḍā dril/ yang thod par lus= shes rab ye shes kyi= thugs kyi= zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs thugs (472)kar thim pas/ de'i thugs ka nas kyang bdud rtsi sngon po byung ste khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang gsum pa dang chos sku thob byung snyam du mdzod/ de nas yang thod par lus bdud rtsir gyur pas mchod de gser gyi maṇḍal phul la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs bzhi'i lha tshogs dbus kyi bla ma la thim/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du gyur nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas chem chem 'ur 'ur 'dug pa la gsol ba drag po btab pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang gi spyi bor thim te/ lus 'od phung du yal nas sems ma bcos par bzhag pas/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa dang bde ba chen po'i sku thob byung snyam du mdzod/ de yang ye shes rgya mtsho las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor las// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// sa lam rim pas bgrod par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar gyi dgos don tshang ba lags/ gsum pa ni/ tshogs la longs spyad/ gtor ma btang*/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bya/ rjes bsngo ba bya/ bla ma lam khyer gyi dbang rdzogs so/// /bde legs su gyur cig // ༈ na maḥtsakra sa ma bha ra/ yi dam lam khyer gyi dbang 'di la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/

dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba dang*/ shar mthing*/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang dang gong ras ljang khu/ mu khyud nag po/ khyams phyogs tshon/ zhes me tog mchod gtor gong bzhin byas nas/ bdag bskyed sngon du song bas mdun bskyed sumbha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma 'dab (473)ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i pang na rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hi dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams g.yas gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga /zhabs g.yas brkyang pas ro'i gdan mnan cing*/ g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de dag gi dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po nas rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar/ bla ma lam khyer gyi skabs bzhin dang*/ mchod bstod bde mchog lha lnga'i skabs bzhin bya/ de nas slob ma rnams mdun du 'khod pa la/ ye shes dbab pa'i gsol btab yan bla ma lam khyer du drangs ba ltar bya/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang*/

lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa'i mthar/ badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod la spos dang ḍā dril bya/ gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i don du khyed rang gi mdun du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i (474)nang du rang lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam la mchod pa phul/ stong gsum 'di'ang gser gyis bkang ba'i maṇḍal du bkod nas phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gi smin mtshams nas bde mchog sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa gar stabs ling ling byung nas khyed rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas bum dbang dang*/ sprul sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ yang mchod pa dang maṇḍal sngar bzhin phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ gsung gi byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gi mgrin pa nas= khyed rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag nas gsang dbang dang longs sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ yang mchod pa sogs nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ thugs kyi byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gi snying ga nas bde mchog sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa gar stabs ling ling byung nas khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag nas dbang gsum pa dang*/ chos sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ yang mchod pa dang sogs nas/ dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs gzhug tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gi gnas gsum nas bde mchog sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med pa gar stabs ling ling byung nas khyed rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi pa dang bde ba chen po'i sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ḍā dril/ rjes yon dbul/ tshogs la longs spyod/ gsum pa maṇḍal gyi rjes bsdu ba ni gong bzhin no/// / (475) yi dam lam khyer gyi dbang rdzogs so/// / ༈ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā kā lā ya/ snang sems lha sku sgyu ma'i lam khyer gyi dbang ni/ chos drug spyi'i dbang bskur bzhin bya'o// sgyu ma'i lam khyer gyi dbang bskur rdzogs so// lam khyer gsum gyi khrid dang lung ma chad par bya'o/// /ga'u ma 'od gsal gyi zab chos/ 'chi med bar do'i zab chos/ 'chug med lam khyer sgyu lus rmi lam kyi zab chos/ mkha' spyod dmar mo la sogs pa 'pho ba'i zab chos yin gsung ngo*// smras pa/ byin rlabs dbang gi sgo glegs mtshams phye ste// zab khrid rin chen do shal spel ba'i srol// dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos kyi zab khyad yin// de phyir 'di 'dra nyams len skal pa bzang shangs chos ni gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ phyag chen bka' lnga rdzogs so/// / ༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir mkha' spyod bka' lnga la// mkha' spyod ma dkar mo// mkha' spyod ma dmar mo// mkha' spyod ma gsum phrugs/ rjes su yi rang*/ smon lam bka' rgya ma dang lnga'o/// / ༈ de las mkha' spyod dkar mo'i byin rlabs bzhugs so/// /ma dang mkhar 'gros rjes bzung dngos grub brnyes// chos kyi rgyal srid mthon por dbang gis phyug /bstan pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan rdo rje'i sku// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// de la 'dir me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar la/ de gnyis dang*/ dkar dmar gsum phrugs rnams su yod pa las/ dang po dkar mo'i byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ mdun gyi stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon dkar po'i chos 'byung mtha' me ri dkar pos bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi dbus su hrīḥyig 'bri/
yang na tshon spungs dkar po byas kyang chog /de'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/

rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes sngon por skad cig gis lam gyis gsal bar gyur par bsgom la oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa ci rigs pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi chos 'byung la dmigs nas/ sumbha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi dbus su yi ge hrī dkar po gcig tu gyur/ hrīḥde las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥde 'od du zhu ba las/ jo mo mkha' spyod ma dkar mo (476)spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ sku mdog dkar mo rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar pa g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba phyir bstan nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyab ngos nas phrag pa la bkal ba/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ me ri dkar po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun mkha' spyod dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ mchod pa byin rlabs dkyus bzhin mdor bsdus byas la/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā rā oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas maṇḍal/ gsol btab rgyun bshags nas bzung*/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyi bar slob ma la bya ba bzhin du slob dpon rang gis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs te bla ma'i bya ba bstan zin no// gnyis pa/ de nas slob ma rnams bos la khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral la 'khod/ maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o na nam mkha' (477)dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos gsan snyam pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod rnam par dag pa theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gsan par bya rgyu'i chos ni/ 'dir ni gupta zhes/ nges par sbas pa'am/ nges par gsang ba zhes pa de cung zad zur chag pa/ ne gu ma zhes yongs su grags pa'i mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang mo 'ja' lus 'chi ba med pa'i sku can des/ gangs can gyi rnal 'byor dbang po khyung po lo tsā ba dang*/ de rjes grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba thang stong rgyal po la zhal dngos su bstan nas gnang ba'i nye brgyud khyad par can dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba mkha' spyod dkar mo'i sgos bka' 'bul ba'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsum/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas pas/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

snying gar hūm̐ byung ste/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes (478) brjod/ bdud rtsi byin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badzra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ zhes dam bzhag bya/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol/ gsum/ khyed rang mkha' spyod ma dkar mor gsal ba'i ngang nas slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog /mdun bskyed rje btsun ma'i sku las rang dang 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad 'od kyis gang*/ lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang*/ rje btsun ma'i sku'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa yin la/ de nas dngos gzhi'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed chos 'byung gi nang du bla ma dang ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i mkha' spyod ma dkar mo spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma nas/ me ri dkar po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de yang nam mkha' la bya lding ba ltar ling ling bzhugs pa la/ dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag (479)la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs spyan drangs/ dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang bcas oṃ gsum ma bzla/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun mkha' spyod dkar mos rdo rje slob ma 'di'i lus dag pa lha skur 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis gsung gi byin rlabs spyan drangs/ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de las gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di'i ngag dag pa sngags su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de las thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mes pa mdzod/

sngar bzhin gyi mthar/ sems dag pa ting nge 'dzin du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yang gnas gsum kar gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal (480)'byor ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ de las sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum nas zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun mkha' spyod dkar mos rdo rje'i slob ma 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum bde stong zung 'jug tu 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtor dbang ni sngar gyi 'bul gtor de ka phyag tu blangs la oṃ gsum mtshar gcig brjod/ des rkyen byas nas gtor ma mkha' spyod ma dkar mor gsal ba de nyid bya 'phur ba bzhin khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor yer gyis byon/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rgyun byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i zhabs su dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes btags pa brjod la mthar bstim mo// rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te rnams dang mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o// mkha' spyod dkar mo'i byin rlabs bshad zin to/// / ༈ gnyis pa mkha' spyod dmar mo'i byin rlabs ni/ sngar byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug gi nang tshan/ 'pho ba'i sgos bka' de ka bskyar ba yin pas/ spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir bskyar nas bya/ bsdu na/ ma byas kyang chog pas mi dgos gsungs pa // ༈ gsum pa mkha' spyod gsum phrugs kyi byin rlabs bya ba la gnyis te sbyor ba dang dngos so// dang po maṇḍal zlum skor/

mu khyud sngon po gzhi ljang gu'i dbus su 'ja' skor dong du mig gsum lta bu la tshom bu re re 'god/ de'i mthar mchod gtor rnams sngar bzhin bsham/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyis bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul gnyis kyi dang po bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la bya zhing yig bdun bzla/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal la (481) dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'ja' 'od rnam lnga'i zlum skor nor bu mig gsum pa lta bu'i g.yas kyi zlum skor du bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gser btso ma lta bu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan chas brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa'o// dbus kyi zlum skor du jo mo mkha' spyod ma dkar mo spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig ge gzigs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing bzhad pa sku mdog dkar mo rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug phyar ba g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba phyir bstan nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyab ngos nas phrag pa la bkal pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa/ me ri dkar po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// g.yon gyi zlum skor du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa sku mdog nag po// phyag g.yas rnams na thod skam gyi phreng ba dang*/ gri gug dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon rnams na thod khrag dang*/ rtse gsum dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ dgra bgegs dang yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de gsum dang rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa de dag gi mtha' bskor dang steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog /mkha' spyod ma dkar mo// ye shes mgon po rnams kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ (482)mdun bskyed la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang*/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can// zhes sogs kyis bstod pa sha lo ka res bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ so so'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba ling ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa rnams gong bzhin dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snams la// zhes sogs kyis phrin bcol bya/ bzlas pa ci 'grub/ de nas maṇḍal dang gsol btab nas bzung 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bdag 'jug blang ngo*// ༈ gnyis pa/ de nas slob ma rnams bos la maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /slob dpon gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni mkha' spyod gsum phrugs kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i ngo skal gnyis su yod pa las phyi ma skabs su babs= de'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsum/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags pa bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de dag gi sku las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ste/

khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas gzhi lus sbyangs te stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams 'khor lo bde mchog gser btso ma lta bu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa// mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan chas brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis (483)su med par bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ snying gar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la slob dpon gyis dri'i thig le byas pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis lus gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying khar zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nas/ da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol// zhes pa'i bar mkha' spyod dkar mo'i skabs bzhin bya/ khyed rang bde mchog ser por gsal ba'i ngang nas sogs 'don bsgyur byas la ye shes dbab/ sngags yi ge bdun pa 'ba' zhig la badzra ā we sha a āḥ/ btags la spros rol bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed kyi maṇḍal ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar brjod de mdun bskyed gsal btab/ de la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/

lan gsum/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dpral bar sku'i mkha' spyod ma dkar mo// mgrin par gsung gi mkha' spyod ma dmar mo// thugs kar thugs kyi mkha' spyod ma mthing ga rnams bzhugs pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ de nas dpral ba'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems de dag la phul bas bzang lan gyi tshul du sku'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung*/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs te sku'i nang thams cad skya mer gyis khengs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi sgo nas bla ma ma mnyes shing thugs 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byas pa sogs lus kyi dam tshig (484)nyams pa thams cad ming tsam yang med par sangs kyis dag /sku'i dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskangs shing khyed rang rnams bla ma sku rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bor thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang bcas/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bāe re ṇī yai/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī yai/ dzo ka dzo ki nī yai/ sarba buddha bo dhi st+wa ya shwa ra ṇaṃ gatstshā mi kyai/ zhes gsol gdab dang bcas pa re byed pa 'og tu yang 'gre'o// yang mgrin pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dmar po nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phul bas bzang lan gyi tshul du gsung gi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung*/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i nang thams cad dmar mer gyis khengs pas/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gi sgo nas bla ma ma mnyes shing thugs 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byas pa sogs ngag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad ming tsam yang med par sangs kyis dag /gsung gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskangs shing khyed rang rnams bla ma gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ khyed rang gi mgrin par thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags bcas gong bzhin/ yang thugs ka'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer sngon po nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams (485)la phul bas bzang len gyi tshul du thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon ba'i rnam par byung*/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i nang thams cad sngo mer gyis khengs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis yid kyi sgo nas bla ma mnyes shing thugs 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byas pa sogs yid kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad ming tsam yang med par sangs kyis dag /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskangs shing khyed rang rnams bla ma thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer sngon po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol stags bcas gong bzhin/ yang gnas gsum gyi mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum nam mkha'i khams gang ba 'phros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phul bas bzang len gyi tshul du sku gsung*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung*/

bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i nang thams cad 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mer gyis khengs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bla ma ma mnyes shing thugs 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byas pa sogs lus kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad ming tsam yang med par sangs kyis dag /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskangs shing khyed rang rnams bla ma ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ khyed (486)rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags bcas gong bzhin bya/ de bla ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yin/ yi dam gyi dbang bzhi'i slad du mdun gyi zlum skor dbus ma'i mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la mos gus byas nas khyed rang rnams la yid kyis dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ snyam pa byas pas mkha' spyod ma de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la 'bul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas mkha' spyod ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ de'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum nam mkha' gang bar byung*/ dkar po de khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba dang*/ dmar po mgrin pa dang*/ sngon po snying kha nas zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum dri ma dag /sku gsum thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi gcig car du thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig /chos skyong gi dbang bzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ g.yon gyi zlum skor gyi ye shes mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po gsal ba la mos gus drag pos bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol snyam pa byas pas/

mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur nas mchod yul thams cad la mchod pa phul/ de dag gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas mgon po'i gnas gsum du thim/ yang mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum nam mkha'i khams gang ba byung*/ dkar po khyed (486)rang rnams kyi dpral bar/ dmar po mgrin par/ sngon po snying kha nas zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi gcig car du thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brjod/ de dag gis mkha' spyod gsum phrugs kyi bka' phul grub pa yin pas/ khas blangs pa'i dam sdom srung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa sogs dang*/ gtong rag gi maṇḍal rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// rjes kyi bya ba maṇḍal la mchod bstod yig brgyas nongs pa bzod gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya ba nyid do// de ltar mkha' spyod byin rlabs cho ga 'di// rang gi dran pa gso dang rang nyid dang*// skal mnyam gzhan la phan par 'gyur snyam nas/ yi ger bris 'di lhag bsam dkar ba yin// zhes pa 'di ni dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung gi zin tho dang*/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod dkar mo'i mngon rtogs kyi yig cha la brten nas mdar grong chen chos 'khor yang rtser/ lcags 'brug zla ba bdun pa'i dus tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ zhes pa'i yi ge nyid rtsa bar bkod/ mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed zhabs tog tu bkod pa'o/// /gsum phrugs kyi bka' bshad zin no/// / ༈ bzhi pa rjes su yi rang gi bka' sngar ma thob pas rgyun rnyed na 'chad thabs 'dir 'bri'o/// / ༈ lnga pa smon lam bka' rgya ma la deng sang lung 'bog pa'i tshul tsam yod pa las/

bka' 'di yin kyi nges pa mi snang la/ 'on kyang sa bcad mi nyams pa'i ched du 'dir smon lam bka' rgya ma la lung mdzad pa zhu/ smras pa/ zab rgyas gdams pa 'tho ba'i sgo 'byed dang*// mkha' spyod ril bu'i dngos grub nye lam mchog /mkha' spyod bka' lngar grags pa'i gser chos 'di// kun la ma grags khyung po'i snyan brgyud yin/ shangs chos ni gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga rdzogs so/// / ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs bya tshul bzhugs so/// / ༈ oṃ (487) swa sti siddhi/ 'khor lo sdom pa dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje rnam par 'joms dang dbyer med pa// khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas gsal bar bya/ de la 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa rnams la gsang sgrub skor lnga'am/ gsum du grags pa las dang po bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyong ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ maṇḍal mu khyud sngon po padma 'dab ma bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu rnams yod pa'i lte bar tshom bu sngon po gcig 'god/ de'i mthar mchod gtor bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya ba ro// dang po ni slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po la bya/ sngags yi ge bdun pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum du bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga byang du lā ma ljang gu/

nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ste/ bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min sogs nas bde mchog lha lnga'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ mchod pa byin brlabs la/ oṃ tsakra samba ra maṇḍal sa pā ri wā ra 'i mthar arghaṃ sogs btags pa'i phyi mchod mtshan sngags de'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings rnams dag dbyings las sogs tshigs bcad kyis mchod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba ling sogs btags (489) pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ de nas mdun bskyed la maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ rgyun bshags/ ye shes dbab pa/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa de'i gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga re re bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba nas bzung*/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa la bka' babs pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum mam/ phyis skyer sgang pa las gsar du nye brgyud du byung ba spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub dang*/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnyis pa bsnan pa'i gsang sgrub skor lnga zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan/ da lam bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun bsgrub cing de la mchod bstod bdag 'jug blangs pa rnams song zin nas/

da slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsum/ mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga la bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i phung khams sbyangs te 'od gsal (490)stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang la skad cig gi bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan can spyan gsum dmar ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs brkyangs g.yon bskum pas bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed lha lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang yi ge bdun pa'i mthar badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ/ btags pa'i sngags brjod/

de ye shes dbab pa yin/ da dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum na sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dngos gzhi byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal mdzad pa zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse la raṃ dmar po rlung gis skyod bzhin pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang bcas pa/ mgrin par bhrūṃ las byung (491)ba'i 'khor lo dmar po dang*/ snying khar yang bhrūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo sngon po// de gnyis ka'ang rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse mo la raṃ dmar po// lte bar zla nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal thob/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i spyi bo'i bde mchog la khyed rang gis mos gus byas pas/ de las sku'i bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i yi ge hūm̐ dkar po dang baṃ dmar po chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas sku'i bde mchog yab dkar/ yum dmar ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang dkar mo'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse rlung gis bskyod pas raṃ las me 'od lhag ge byung*/ de phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te/ spyi bo'i lha lnga la phul bas/ de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bsdus/ spyi bo'i lha lnga la thim pas rkyen byas yab yum snyoms par zhugs/

rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang yab kyi kha ṭwāṃ ga dang sbyar ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung*/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ yang mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i mgrin pa'i bde mchog la khyed rang gis mos gus byas pas/ de las gsung gi bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i yi ge hūm̐ dang baṃ dmar po chad/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas/ gsung gi bde mchog yab yum dmar ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang dmar mo'i rnam pa can/ rtsibs kyi rtse rlung gis bskyod pa'i raṃ las me 'od lhag ge byung*/ de phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te (492)mgrin pa'i lha lnga la phul bas de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus// mgrin pa'i lha lnga la thim pas rkyen byas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang yab kyi kha ṭwāṃ ga dang sbyar ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dmar po byung*/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de bzhin du snying kha'i 'khor lo dang*/ thugs kyi bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i yi ge hūm̐ sngon po zhes sogs 'don bsgyur gyis/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sogs 'gre/ yang khyed rang gi gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ lus thams cad khengs/ mthar spyi bo'i lha lnga mgrin pa'i lha lnga la thim/ de snying kha'i lha lnga de la thim/ gnas gsum gyi lte ba'i gdan dang 'khor lo rnams 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de yum la thim/ de yab la thim/ de je phra je chung la nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i gnas lugs de'i ngang du cung zhig 'jog par zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de dbang bzhi pa yin no//

zhes brda sprad/ de dag gis bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi bka' grub zin pas/ dbang dus su thob pa'i dam sdom srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal sogs spyi ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ yig brgyas nongs pa bzod gsol bsdu chog rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi sgos bka' bshad zin to/// / ༈ na mo gu ra be/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su tshom bu sngon po gcig /mtha' mchod (493) gtor sogs kyis bskor ba sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya rgyu'i chos so// dang po skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ skad cig gi padma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa rā dzi ta'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang pos sdig mdzub bsgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ gnyis su med par thim/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon bgegs rigs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i dang la ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang zla ba sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/

zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ badzra pā ṇi sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa gong bzhin mthar 'dod gsol bya/ de nas maṇḍal gsol gdab nas bzung*/ ye shes dbab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi bar 'og tu slob ma la bya ba bzhin slob dpon gyis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du bya ba yin no/// / ༈ gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma gral la (494) 'khod pa la sems can thams cad kyi don du/ zhes sogs sems bskyed brda sprad/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor lnga zhes grags pa'i nang tshan/ da lan 'dir phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i phung khams sbyangs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang nas skad cig gis padma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa rā dzi ta'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon dang pos sdig mdzub bsgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i phyag na (495)rdo rje'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam du spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang*/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod la ye shes dbab/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par skur du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnams par spyan drangs te bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las sku'i byin rlabs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang*/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ā be sha ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ (496)de las gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo gyur pa'i 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol gong ltar/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de las thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol gong ltar/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum la thim/ de las sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum nas zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol gong ltar bya/ de ltar dbang bzhi bskur ba la brten nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag pas/

khyed rang rnams skad cig gis padma dang zla ba'i steng du phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po gsal btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig (497)gnyis pa dang sngags phreng 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng 'khod par bsam la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra ha ri dza ha na ha na sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor gtang pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig / ces brjod/ de dag gis phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi bka' phul grub pa yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya/ gsum pa rjes bsdu ba spyi dang 'dra'o// phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bshad zin to/// / ༈ na mo gu ra we/ 'dir rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i steng du mañdzi'i khar bum pa rgyan ldan bcud kyis gang ba bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor dang*/ spro na bgegs gtor bsham/ gnyis pa la/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing ga g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ (498)thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam 'joms ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ de'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/ gzungs ring ngam/ yang snying*/ na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro dhā ya sogs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bzla/ mdun gyi maṇḍal lar dmigs nas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan de'i steng du hūm̐/ bum pa'i nang du yang pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐/ hūm̐ gnyis ka yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing kha zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed dang bum nang gi dam tshig pa so so la gnyis su med par thim/ mchod pa byin brlab/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de nas bum nang gi lha'i sku lus thams cad las sngags phreng rang sgra sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa 'u ru ru 'phros/ bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ na maḥtsaṇḍa sogs kyi yang snying brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ de nas 'jug pa'i maṇḍal nas bzung*/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/
