slob ma bos la/ phyag dang maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor bsngos nas gtor ma phyi rol du dor ba dang bgegs bskrad/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos gsan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa nas (459)'byung ba ltar gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor lnga'i nang nas 'dir rnam 'joms gsang sgrub yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsol btab nas bzung ste/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar thams cad la lha sngags brje ba ma gtogs phyag rdor ji lta ba bzhin byas pas don 'grub bo// de nas/ na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra sogs brjod cing bum pa thogs la/ bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med pa des khyed rang rnams kyi lus bkrus pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/

yang snying brjod cing gdong la sogs pa khru/ mthar bcu gsum re 'thung du gzhug /de dag gis rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi bka' grub pa yin zhing*/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig bzung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang gtong rag gi maṇḍal phul/ gsum pa rjes bsdu chog spyi dang 'dra ba bya'o// ༈ 'di'i gsang sgrub bka' rgya ma'i rgyun khyer nyams su len tshul ni/ tho rangs gzhan dang ngag ma 'dres pa'i lto stong mar skyabs sems sngon 'gros// rang lus ye nas bum pa ni// rang chas grub te sgra sna dag /bum pa'i kha rgyan shing lo nyid// mgul pa bum pa'i mgrin pa'o// gsus pa bum pa'i lto ba ldir// rdo rje nor bu bum pa'i mchu// srin zhal 'og sgo bum pa'i zhabs// rkang pa bum pa'i zhabs steg go /lhun gyis grub pa'i lte ba'i nang*// pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hūm̐// de mthar gzungs ring tshar gsum gyi// sngags phreng lan gsum bskor bar gyur// hūm̐ dang gzungs las 'od (500)'phros pas// sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mchod// de kun byin rlabs 'od zer tshogs// tshur 'dus sngags phreng rnams la thim// gzungs ring bdun lnga gsum gyi bar// rgyas bsdus longs skabs bstun la bzla// sngags phreng 'od du zhu ba las// khrus chu gdon la khro chung dang*// bar chad srung la rdo rje'i rdul// phra mo mtshor 'khyil me 'od 'phro// chu phung phar btang bar ba nas// khyor ba gsum btung khrus bya'o// de nas nad rims mtha' dag dang*// grib gdon kun las rgyal ba yi// gsang ba'i khrus chog zab mo 'di// skal ldan re re tsam la'o// zhes pa'i don nyams su blang ngo*// 'di la 'jags pa lung tsam la brten/ byin rlabs 'di bsam sding pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung*// 'di rmi lam gyi khrid kyi skabs su gnang na 'brel chags te rmi lam 'di grib la sdang bas de sel byed kyi thabs su 'gro// gsang sgrub bka' lngar byed la/

spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub dang*/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnyis bsnan pas lngar 'gro ba yin no// de ltar gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi lag len khrig chags/ 'di ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung rgyun tho yig la brten/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis lcags 'brug zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin 'dir grong chen chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla brang gi dbang khang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ zhes pa'i yi ge rtsa bar bkod/ mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed zhabs tog gi tshul du bsgrubs so// smras pa/ mkhas grub brgyud pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las// 'thon pa'i gsang sgrub skor gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// dri med byin rlabs zil dngar ma nyams par// bdag blo'i yol gor 'khyil 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ shangs chos ni gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ gsang sgrub skor gsum rdzogs so/// / ༈ mkha' 'gro su kha siddhi'i byin rlabs kyi bka' bzhugs so/// / ༄༅/ bde ba'i dpal rgyun mi nub rdzogs ldan dpyid// (501) grub pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dge legs rab tu spel ba'i dbyangs bdun 'khrol// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// 'dir mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi'i byin rlabs la sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po yi dam mthun gyi gnas su bca' gzhi maṇḍal dbus dkar dmar/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i 'dab ma bzhi mtha' me ri 'bar ba/ dbus su tshom bu dkar dmar gcig 'god/ mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi yo byang sogs dkyus bzhin bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po de nas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang*/

swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ dbu skra sil bur 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing*/ g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi rnam pa/ spyan gsum hrig ge gzigs pa/ ye shes kyi sku can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi ye shes pa la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥsu kha siddhi hūm̐ gis bskor ba la dmigs te sngags de nyid nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla ba ni bdag bskyed do// mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus na padma dang zla ba'i gdan la mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ mdun (502)bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ gu ru ḍā ki nī su kha siddhi sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gang gi gsang gsum zla ba'i 'od zer gyis// bde chen snying gi ku mud bzhad mdzad pa'i// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med rje btsun ma// su kha siddhi'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gu ru ḍā ki nī su kha siddhi 'i mthar i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa gong bzhin mthar 'dod gsol bya/

de nas 'jug pa'i maṇḍal nas bzung ye shes dbab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba/ nam mkha' dang rang sems bsres nas ci gnas kyi ngang du rang babs su 'jog pa'i bar bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// ༈ ga nyis pa de nas slob ma bos la/ khrus phyag maṇḍal 'bul ba rnams byar gzhug / sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs dang*/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni mkhas grub khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa la bla ma mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ rdo rje 'chang la chos dngos su gsan pa'i ye shes kyi ḍā ki rnam pa gnyis kyi nang tshan su kha siddhi 'am/ bde ba sbyin du grags pa'i byin rlabs yin/ mkha' 'gro ma 'di'i lo rgyus ni rgya gar kha chen grong khyer chen po 'bum tsho sum cu so brgyad yod pa las/ 'di nub byang gi grong khyer du byung ste/ de yang grong khyer de na bza' mi gnyis la bu gsum// bu mo gsum yod pa shin tu dbul zhing phongs par gyur na rgyags 'bras bum pa gang las med pa/ de za ma nus par kha bcang sbas nas bzhag go /de nas bu gsum lho phyog su zas tshol du song*/ bu mo gsum yang byang du song*/ pha de nub phyogs su song*/ de na ma de khyim du 'dug pa na shin tu bkris shing phongs pa gcig zas slong du byung bas/ mas de la 'bras kyi bum pa kha phye nas btsos te byin no// der pha dang bu mo la sogs pa de kun gyis ci yang ma (503)rnyed par ltogs pas/ da ni khyim gyi 'bras bum pa gang po za'o snyam nas dus gcig la log nas/ mal 'bras bum pa gang po byin cig smras pa dang*/ ma na re/ khyed rang rnams kyi zas rnyed nas 'ong snyam ste 'dir slong ba po zhig byung ba la byin nas med smras pas/ khyod kyis sngar yang 'di bzhin byas pas skyid du ma ster ba yin/ 'dir ma 'dug zer nas khyim nas bskrad do// de nas rgan mo des nub phyogs o rgyan du phyin nas/ der slebs pa tsam gyis rig pa rang bzhin gyis dwangs par song*/

dus der 'bras khal gcig rnyed pa rgyur byas te chang tshong ba'i las byed cing yod pa na/ de'i nags khrod cig na slob dpon bir wa pa gsang spyod mdzad pa'i phyag rgya mo de chang nyo ba la 'ongs te/ rgan mos chang 'di su la 'dren byas pas/ nga'i 'di nags khrod ya gi na rnal 'byor pa gcig bzhugs pa la 'dren zer/ 'o na chang rin mi dgos snams shig byas nas chang bum pa gang bskur ro// der slob dpon gyis dri ba mdzad pa la phyag rgya mos rgan mo zhig gis dad pas phul ba yin tshul zhus pas/ de khrid shog gsungs nas/ rgan mo la bzlas pas/ shin tu dga' nas yang chang bum pa gang dang*/ phag sha gcig khyer nas mjal bar phyin pas/ bir wa pas dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba la brten nas rgan mo de rnam smin gyi lus 'ja' lus du song ste/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi zhes bya ba 'di nyid du gyur pa yin no// mkha' 'gro ma 'dis khyung po rnal 'byor pa la tsan dan sman gyi nags tshal du shing tā la bdun srid gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs nas zhal bstan cing dbang dang gdams pa ma lus gnang zhing brgyud pa phyi ma phal cher la yang zhal dngos su bstan pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang po yod la/ su kha chos drug gi gdams pa rnams (504)sngar snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa las/ phyis su zha lu sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rjes khrid yig mdzad nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la byin rlabs sngon du 'gro dgos pa yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsum/ mdun bskyed mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ de nas slob dpon mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhir gsal ba la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed ḍā ki'i tshogs kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar dmar dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus sbyangs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i ngang las khyed rang gi go sar padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ dbu skra sil bur 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi rnam pa/ spyan gsum hrig ge gzigs pa/ ye shes kyi sku can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed mkha' 'gro ma'i (505)tshogs kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang ḍā ki ma su kha siddhi'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang*/ oṃ āḥsu kha siddhi hūm̐ badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes mang du brjod/ de nas mdun gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i su kha siddhi bzhugs pa la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol//

zhes lan gsum/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal btab pa'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ khyed rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥsu kha siddhi hūm̐ badzra ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes sngags dang bcas pa'i ḍā dril bya ba 'og tu yang 'gre/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ khyed rang gi snying ga nas zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mdun bskyed gyi gnas gsum kyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du (506)thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ mthar khyed rang rnams lus gnad bcas te/ mig mdun gyi bar snang stong pa la har re ltos mdzod/ slob dpon mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhir gsal ba'i phyag g.yon khu tshur la mdzub mo nam mkhar bsgreng ba skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad de/ zhal nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ngo sprad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rig pa rten med du zhogs dang rnal 'byor pa// nam mkha' rig med stong pa la// rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gcun// rtsa ba gcun la lhug par zhog / ces lan gsum brjod la/ de'i don nam mkha' dang khyed rang gi sems dbyer med du bsres nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la skye 'jig med pa bzhin tu rang sems la skye 'jig med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dang dbus dang ngos bzung ci yang med pa bzhin rang sems kyang de ltar shes par byas la de ka'i ngang du 'dzin pa mi bya/ bcas bcos mi bya rang babs su zhog mdzod/

ces brjod/ des mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi'i byin rlabs phul grub pa yin pas/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa sogs dang gtong rag gi maṇḍal bya/ 'di la nges par tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad/ ༈ gsum pa rjes yig brgyas nongs pa bzod gsol bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ mthar bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis kyi phreng bas mtha' brten par bya'o// 'di yang ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung rtsa bar bkod nas mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed zhabs tog gi tshul du bris pa yin no// bde ba'i dngos grub ma'i bka' bshad zin no// ༈ lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi bka' bzhugs// na mo gu ra we/ 'dir lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi bka' bya ba la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ dang po maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la tshom bu sngon po// shar gyi pad 'dab la nyi gdan tshom bu nag po// lho'i pad 'dab la dmar po/ nub tu dkar (907) po// byang du ljang khu ste tshom bu lnga bkod/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskar ra// yang 'di'i bca' gzhi bla ma lam khyer dang 'dra ba byas kyang rung ngo*//

༈ ga nyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi lam dang slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyi rol du me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur rnams su gyur/ de'i nang du rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde ba 'char zhing rgyas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su padma 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer 'phro ba'o// mdun gyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog char sprin ltar nag po/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug /bar pas thod pa'i phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag /bar pas rtse gsum/ tha mas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom brjid pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ lto ba (508)'phyang zhing yan lag rnams sbom la rags pa/ dpral bar sin dhū ras byugs shing*/ phyag dang zhabs rnams dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/

glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na tshogs bdag dkar po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// g.yas kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po las gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba nas tsam 'bur ba/ spyan gsum gson phyogs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed ngang dus mtshan mnan pa'o// rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa las spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas pas bum pa dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad dkar kha bye ba/ dbu skra dpung pa'i steng na sil le yod pa 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ g.yon gyi pad 'dab gyi zla gdan la taṃ las utpal tāṃ gis mtshan pa las rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu/ lang tsho dar la bab cing*/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ spyi bor don yod grub pas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi (509)dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus pa rdo rje 'chang dang lha bzhi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/

skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba snyom 'jug gi bde ba/ de kho na nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mnyes par bgyi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bī re ṇī ye/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nā yai/ dzo ka dzo ki nī yai/ sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa ya sha ra ṇa gatstshā mi kyai/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ de bzhin du lha so so la dmigs te rim bzhin sngags brjod pa ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi na yā ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsum/ mgon po'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs= mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ ces sogs rigs 'gre/ oṃ badzra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsum/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku las= oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra rakṣa na maḥs manta hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku las= oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ gsum/ sgrol ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par gyur/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lha bzhi spyan drangs bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ (510)thugs kar mgon po// lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ sngags tshan lnga sbrel nas lan gsum bzla/ rang gi gsang gnas nas rlung g.yos/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar/ bla ma'i sku la phog pas bde ba chen pos lha bzhi bdud rtsir zhu nas sku lus gang*/

gsang ba'i lam nas rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ snying kha yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lte ba yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas/ rang lus 'od du yal/ sems ma bcos pa la mnyam par bzhag go / de nas maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba khru gang gis mtho ba la nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ zhes pa nas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ gu ru de ba tsa tu ra sa pā rī wā ra arghaṃ la sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ gsang mchod dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yid kyis bya/ gang gi drin gyis sogs sha lo ka gcig dang*/ byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo// dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i gnas// bar chad ma lus sel ba'i lha// bla ma lha bzhi'i tshogs la 'dud// ces bstod/ gtor ma yod na dbul lo// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ khrus phyag sngon 'gros maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs sems bskyed gsal btab/ gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor (511)la bla ma mang du yod pa'i nang nas lho phyogs kyi rā hu la zhes grags pa'i grub thob chen po de la rdo rje mkha' spyod mas gnang ga ji skad du ma yengs zla ba gsum nas 'grub// tho rangs thun re ma chags bsgom// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'grub// ces gsungs te// de lta bu'i byin rlabs bla ma lha bzhi'i bka' 'bul bar byed pa la/

slob dpon gyi bya ba sngon du grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsum/ mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar rgyun bshags dang sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ de nas slob dpon bla ma lha bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la mos gus drag po dud pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bla ma lha bzhi'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i snang zhen sbyangs te lus yi dam gang byed kyi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gong bzhin bskyed chog gi tshig brjod nas lha rnams dam tshig pa'i tshul du bskyed la/ de nas mdun bskyed maṇḍal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rdo rje 'chang la thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i (512)mos pa mdzod/ spos dang ḍā dril bya zhing*/ na mo buddha ya'i gsol 'debs tshar gsum brjod/ yang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i mgon po la thim/ sku las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhal du dmar chem chem gsol/

mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dang sgo gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos dang ḍā dril mgon po'i sngags lan gsum gyis byin rlabs 'babs pa 'gre'o// yang rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon// khyed rang gi spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ gsang gnas nas bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags tshar gsum/ yang thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la thim/ bum pa dang sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod cing spos ḍā dril/ yang sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid yer gyis byon/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la thim/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang ḍā dril bya/ de nas dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon (513)du maṇḍal/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sogs gsum/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ lha bzhi spyan drangs te bla ma'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs/ mgrin par sgrol ma/ thugs kar mgon po/ lte bar rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa la mos gus dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo buddhā ya/ sogs nas/ tu re swā hā 'i bar/ sngags tshan lnga sprel ba lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang gi rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar ba'i 'od zer bla ma'i sku la phog

/lha bzhi 'od du zhu/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang gi spyi bor zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob// sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis snying ga yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lte ba yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang la thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med du gyur par mos la sems 'dzin med du ci gnas mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ḍā dril drag tsam re bya ba ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos/ des lha bzhi'i bka' grub pa yin/ dam sdom srung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa sogs bya/ gsum pa rjes ni/ yig brgyas bzod par gsol zhing*/ las kyi nges mi mngon par bya'o// (514) lha bzhi'i bka' bshad zin to// smras pa/ byin rlabs 'byung gnas su kha siddhi dang*// lho phyogs bla ma'i snyan brgyud lha bzhi'i bka'// dpal ldan shangs pa'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du// ma sbas gsal bar phye nas bkod pa yin// shangs chos ni gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ byin rlabs zur rgyan gyi bka' rdzogs so/// / ༄༅/ na mo gu ru ma hā kā lā ya/ 'dir mgon po'i bka' lnga la/ rjes gnang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ grib sel/ gnad dbab/ gsang sgrub dang lnga yod pa las/

dang po rdzas gnang la mi 'dra ba bcu gsum tsam gyi bka' bzhugs par grags kyang*/ gtso bor bar chad kun sel gyi bka' bya ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba// dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni gnas dben par maṇḍal chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ yig sngon po bri/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar nas nag rjen btags byas pa'i gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum mtha' theb kyus bskor brgyan dang bcas pa la mda' dar nag po me long gis brgyan pa btsugs pa bzhag /de'i rgyab tu mgon po'i bris sku yod na bkram/ mtha' mchod pa dang gtor mas bskor ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyis bsgrub pa'i rim pa dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma rnams mgon po 'khor bcas su bskyed cing mchod gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa rnams rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga phrin las gter mdzod ji bzhin bya ba nyid do// ༈ gnyis pa slob ma rnams khrus byas me tog dang bcas te gral la 'khod par 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o//

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i thugs bskyed khyad par can gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang cag rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba mi'i lus rten bzang po thob/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags (515)rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ snying thag pa nas chos la 'bad dgos/ chos sgrub pa la deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mthun rkyen nyung zhing 'gal rkyen mang ba yin te// yum las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la de la 'tshe ba mang*/ zhes gsungs pas/ de'i gnyen por chos skyong khyad par can re bsten dgos/ de la mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud pa 'di'i phyag bzhes dang*/ bod kyi lha min 'dre min bsten pa'i lugs mi gcig /grub thob gtsang brgyud kyi srol skyong ba khyung po rnal 'byor gyi chos lugs yin/ khong gis mgon po phyag drug pa 'di rgya gar nas bod du spyan drangs pa yin te/ khyung pos rgya gar du byon nas/ bla ma mai tri pa ko sa la bhi kṣa'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa la/ gser srang bdun phul nas/ nged bod rnams longs spyod chung ba yin pas/ nor sgrub myur la ltag tshan che ba zhig zhu byas pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsan dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya ba/ tshe 'di dang bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba/ mi nor rdzas gsum shugs la 'byung ba/ dgra thams cad rlag par byed pa/ zlog pas mi tshugs pa/ mchog thun mongs thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa/

mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhor la 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba gcig yod pa de sbyin gsung ngo*// de bla mas su la zhus byas pas/ kho bos dpal sha wa ri pa la thob/ dpal sha wa ri pa zhes bya ba de ni bram ze'i rigs su gyur pa/ dpal 'bras spungs dang nye bar grong khyer chen po sum bcu rtsa gnyis (516)yod pa'i dbus na/ tri pa la bya ba rol mo mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur nas/ sngon sangs rgyas la glu dang rol mo'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa de/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi 'jag ma'i spyil bu gcig na sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs yod pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas rigs kyi bu nga'i sgrub thabs zungs shig gsungs nas/ sha wa ri pas sgrub thabs 'di ye ger bkod/ yang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang*// thugs rje chen po dang*/ sgrol ma gsum byon nas sgrub thabs kyi lung gsungs te bsngags par mdzad do// de lta bu'i bla ma de lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i dus su kho bos phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud dang gdams ngag zhus/ de'i dus su phyag drug pa 'di gnang nas bsgrubs pas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig nas zhal mthong ba yin no// da khyung po rnal 'byor khyod kyis kyang*/ phyag drug pa 'di la nas nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ spos sbyor mchad par gyis/ khyi nag po la rdo ma rdeg /yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ de ltar byas pas dngos grub thams cad tshul bzhin du ster bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan nas bka' bsgo lan gsum gyi bar mdzad nas gnang ngo*// gzhan yang sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su dur khrod chen po mun pa mi zad pa zhes bya bar/ slob dpon chen po dan sang skṛ ta zhes bya bas/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing*/

'khor tshogs dbang du bsdus nas las thams cad sgrub par mdzad pa'i bla ma des/ rā hu la gupta badzra la zhal gzigs nye brgyud kyi tshul du gnang*/ des khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul 'jog po'i ri la bzhugs dus rgya gar nas nam langs pa la phebs te/ bod du nyi shar la gdams pa sgo bskyel mdzad pa (517)byung ba yin no// de lta bu'i mgon po 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang ba'i rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba/ chos byed phal cher yang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas/ de dag gi gnyen por thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag gcig spros pa las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'dir gyur pa dang*/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ rigs kyi bu/ sems can gyi re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i spyod pa 'di lta bu ni shin tu legs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa mgon po 'di'i che ba'i yon tan dang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa bka' stsal to// mdor na byang chub kyi spyod pa sgrub cing chos snying thag pa nas byed pa la chos skyong 'di las byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba gzhan med pas yid ches drag pos nyams su len pa gal che/ de la sgrub thabs kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs na'ang*/ rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ drag po mthu sgrub dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub gnyis yin/ de gnyis kyi yang gtso bo drag po mthu sgrub yin cing*/ 'di la'ang bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du yod mod kyi/ de rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bka' ni bar chad kun sel gyi bka' 'di nyid yin pas/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la yang*/ maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/

thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ste drug yod pa las/ dang po bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul (518)mdzod/ nyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ gsum pa rtog pa bsdu ba 'di la gsan pas khyab bo// rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// zhes de ltar na snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan 'tshal/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi skyabs 'gro'i don ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ lnga pa rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum/ drug pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa la yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dang myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/

yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ (519) lan gsum/ de dag gis dbang gi sbyor ba grub pa yin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang dngos bskur ba la yang*/ ye shes dbab pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa/ sku dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa/ sngags gtad pa'i rjes gnang ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan pa'i don/ dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa dang*/ ye shes phab pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po 'khor bcas gsal 'debs pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ sma ra smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar sindhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa (520)bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/

stag lpags kyi sham thabs la dar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ska rags can/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag trags pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran can dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ bdud dang bgegs thams cad rlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsan dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ 'khor sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o// gtso bo'i mdun du gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la/ sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas/ lha dang lha ma yin thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ (521)dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ g.yas su dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdag dkar nag /g.yas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu gshin rje ṭākki rā dza sku mdog dkar nag /phyag g.yas zhags pa dgra la 'phen cing*/ g.yon sdig mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon chen po trakshad sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas ru mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying gar bsnun pa/

g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ sag ti'i lh+wam yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang khro bo'i las mkhan gyi cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po// nub tu chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du 'byung po// steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa bdag ste phyogs skyong bcu/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol pa/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su (322)gang ba/ thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o// de lta bu'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa la/ mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer bun gyis 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs nas 'od phung du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi go sar paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du// baṃ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros// dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs nas/ tsan dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o// de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo dar dang bcas shing*/ (523)g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra si li li/ khro lo lo// 'ur 'ur chem chem byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim/

rol mo'i sgra cher bya/ dam rdzas sbos gyi dud pa btul/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra kṣiṃ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sogs nyer gcig /kṣiṃ gi gnas su/ e hye hi bcug pa dang*/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa rnams lan gsum gsum/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes brjod de ye shes dbab pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga gsal btab la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ khyad par bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas tshur bsdus te oṃ la thim/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas bum dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo bya/ yang gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ mgrin pa'i āḥ= gsung gi byin rlabs= mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po= khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i ā la thim pas gsang dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces 'don bsgyur rigs 'gre/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol// thugs ka'i hūm̐= thugs (524)kyi byin rlabs= thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing ga= khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ sher dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol snyam pa dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum po de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de yang spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ des lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas/ dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin pas/ sems spros bral phyag rgya chen po la zhog mdzod/ rol mo/ gsum pa sku dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa ni gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla mas khyed rang rnams kyi bar chad srung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par bka' bskos pa'i tshe/ khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad mgon po'i zhal du sha chom rus chom du gsol zhing*/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad srung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par ngas bya'o// zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par sgoms mdzod/ ces gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzung la rol mo dang bcas pas bka' bsgo ba ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po phyag drug pa/ ma gcig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ 'khor gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la/ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra/ gshin rje ṭākki rā dza/ bdud mgon trakshad nag po// phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon bdun cu/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis (525)rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po// dpal ldan sha wa ri dbang phyug /grub chen mai tri pa chen po// rā hu la gupta/ mkhas grub khyung po lo tsā ba/ rmog lcogs pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos rjes sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston rin chen 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims snying po// grub chen sangs rgyas seng ge/ mkhas btsun shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/

lkugs lung pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor sems kyi mdud 'grol/ chos sku lha dbang grags pa/ mnyam med dad sgrol mgon po// 'dren mchog byams pa kun dga'/ rwa pa ngag dbang phrin las/ gnas brtan rin chen rgya mtsho// dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ bya btang kun bzang dbang po// rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho// dbon chos dbyings rang grol// rje btsun kun bzang chos 'byor/ rtsa ba'i bla ma a wa dhū ti pa chen po mthu stobs mtshan can gyi bar du byon pa'i dpal ldan bla ma de rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di dag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang*/ dgra dang bgegs la sogs pa'i gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ mdor na byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung ba dang bskyabs pa dang*/ spa ba'i phrin las mdzad nas/ mi 'dod pa thams cad sol/ 'dod don thams cad sgrubs/ ji ltar bcol pa'i las thams (526)bcad la thogs pa med par mdzod cig /bzhi pa sngags lung gi don du slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba lan gsum 'debs dgos pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis kyang*/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ gi mthar snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar sgom la/ mos gus dung pa dang bcas me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng me 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer dmar nag 'phro ba de dag las/

sngags phreng mar po gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags thams cad kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar nag me 'od du 'phro bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed pa dang bcas pa'i sngags phreng sgor gyis byung ba'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la shā sa na/ u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣo3 pashtsi ma ka lo a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka rī ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si tā dā/ i dam duṣṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ shrī de wī hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ kṣe tra pā la bighnān hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra ba shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭākki rā dza sa ma ya bhyoḥdu dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga ja ma hā kā la trakshad hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang lan gsum (527) gsum bzla'o// mthar slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs mtha' dag gis brgyud brlan pa'i mos pa mdzod de yan gyis dngos gzhi grub zin/ gsum pa rjes la/ dam tshig bzung ba/ yon dbul ba/ smon lam gdab pa ste gsum las dang po ni deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyis yongs su blangs pa'i bslab pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang*/ khyad par sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang*/ sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag ma nyams pa gal che/ yang sgos mgon po nyid kyi dam tshig 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ dam rdzas kyi spos sbyor ma chad par gyis/ bya nag dang byi nag la rdo mi rdeg

/yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ 'byung po gzhan la zas phud mi 'bul/ sdig can gtum po klogs su mi bsten/ khyad par chos skyong 'di nyid gsang ba dang*/ sngags dang man ngag gsang ba dang*/ dus rgyun dang khyad par gyi mchod gtor la brtson pa gal che ba lags so// de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs bya/ gnyis pa gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul mdzod/ 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum bya/ gsum pa chos gsan pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bya/ bar chad kun sel gyi gtor dbang 'di la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las mgon po dkar dmar mthing gsum spro ba dang bcas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i lugs dang*/ rgyas par byed tshe sku spro ba'i dbang bzhi/ gsung yig 'bru'i dbang bzhi/ thugs 'od zer gyi dbang bzhi// yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bzhi/ phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang bzhi dang bcas pa ting nge 'dzin gyi (528) dbang nyi shu bskur ba zhang sgom chen po'i phyag bzhes yin te/ de 'dra'i khyad par ma phyed pa'i phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang tsam mtha' rten du sbyar ba'i rang bzo'i yi ge mang bar 'dug kyang bka' brgyud 'di'i lugs las phyi rol du gyur pa yin pas snying po chu'i lbu ba dang 'dra'o// rjes mchod bstod/ bzod gsol bya zhing gtor ma'i ye shes pa bris sku'i thugs kar thim/ oṃ badzra muḥ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdus la gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te bris sku'i lha la phul/ brtan bzhugs bsngo smon dang bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod/ khrid don gnyer can yin na/ rje grub chen gyi yi ge bzhin bla mgon dbyer med kyi khrid dang lung ma chad par chos skor cha lag tshang ba'i ched du byed pa gal che'o/// /smras pa// bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub pa la// byin rlabs bka' srung gzhan dang khyad zhugs pa'i// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i chos mdzod sgo// 'byed pa'i lde mig tsam 'dis mthar dge byas// shangs chos ne gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag len bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/

bka' srung mgon po'i rtsa ba'i bka' lnga rdzogs so/// /zab gsang rgyud sde'i mthar thug snying po rnams lnga'i bcud// ḍā ki'i ded dpon mchog gis bzung ba'i nor bu mchog /grol lam re re'ang smin byed rjes su 'jug pa yis// yid ches ngo mtshar ster ba 'di ni ne gu'i srol// de phyir lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis// mtha' yas gdul bya'i rgyud kyi snye ma 'bras ldan du// smin byed tshogs rdzogs par skrun pa'i thabs tshul rnams// phyogs gcig go sla'i ngag gi srad bus chun por bsdebs// a ho khyung po'i phyag bzhes gtsang ma lha yi chu// ma dag mu cor rnyogs mas bslad rnams phra zhib kyi// rnam dpyod nor bu ke ta ka yis drung phyung nas// legs bshad dwangs bsil bstan 'dzin tshogs la mchod yon no// gang las thob pa'i bsod nams dkar po'i 'dzum zer gyis// 'gro kun ma rig thibs por zhugs pa'i mun 'phrog nas// yang dag lam la lta ba'i blo mig rab sbyangs te// bde chen sku gsum nor bu'i khang par phyin gyur cig /ces dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs (529)rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bo'i mdzes rgyan du phebs par brten/ snyoms las pa zlo gsal bstan skyong gis/ yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo/ gro zhun zla ba'i dmar po'i phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro 'du tshes la mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal zhwa lu ri phug gi gzim khang rnam grol yang rtser sbyar ba 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig// /maṅga lam/// /
